title: System Design for the AI Era - Episode 1
content: System Design for the AI Era - Episode 1 introduces load balancing, distributed systems, and the addition of new AI layers including AI models, agents, memory, RAG, vector databases, model routing, MCP, tool calling, and multi-agents. The speaker emphasizes that this series will explain these concepts visually and simply, making them understandable. The episode starts with a simple question: 'Imagine I tell you to build me a chat application. You might create a frontend, backend, and add a database, resulting in a chat application. However, if I change the requirement to support 10 million users instead of 100, everything changes. Where do you store millions of messages? What happens when thousands of people send messages at the exact same time? What happens if.'
